model.name: roof_unet_ft
model.architecture: U-Net, 3 down/up levels, 7.8 M parameters, sigmoid output (binary roof / not roof)
model.input: RGB image, any size; internally BGR 0-1; tiled above ~860 px
model.base_weights: dida roof task U-Net by Abhirup Ghosh (MIT), trained on 25 labelled 256×256 satellite images
model.fine_tuned_on: SpaceNet 2 Vegas and Paris building footprints (CC BY-SA 4.0): see docs/roof/MODEL_AND_LICENSES.md for the held-out evaluation

summary.total_area_meaning: Plan-view (horizontal projection) measurements; valid for near-nadir imagery

derived: areas and lengths when a scale exists

unavailable.ridge: Needs 3D information or a trained line classifier. Interior edges are listed as unclassified candidates.
unavailable.eave: A nadir image cannot tell eaves from rakes. Outline edges are listed without that classification.
unavailable.facet: Splitting a roof into planes needs height or slope information that one image does not contain.
